Open the ezrsurvey profile for editing

Source: R/config.R
edit_ezrsurvey_profile.Rd

Opens your ezrsurvey YAML profile in the editor (like usethis::edit_r_profile() for .Rprofile), creating it from a template first if it does not exist. After saving, reload it with load_ezrsurvey_profile() or by restarting the session.

Usage

edit_ezrsurvey_profile(path = NULL)

Arguments

path

Profile path. If NULL (default), the first existing profile among ezrsurvey_profile_paths() is used, or the per-user config file is created.

Value

Invisibly the path opened.

See also

use_ezrsurvey_profile(), save_ezrsurvey_profile(), load_ezrsurvey_profile().

Other config: apply_order(), ezrsurvey_options(), ezrsurvey_profile_paths(), get_dataset(), get_order(), list_orders(), load_ezrsurvey_profile(), order_for(), register_order(), register_order_presets(), remove_order(), reset_ezrsurvey_options(), save_ezrsurvey_profile(), use_dataset(), use_ezrsurvey_profile()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
edit_ezrsurvey_profile()
} # }
